task: RoboGauge MoE-CTS two-step ascent and stop before wall

author_constant.aggregation: Excess counts divided by pooled physics-joint samples; peaks are maxima, never averaged
author_constant.limitations: This finite MuJoCo test is not real-world validation or permission to actuate the robot; stop_on_platform depends on external ground truth.

command_note: 0.6 m/s is a command. stop_on_platform is an external simulation-ground-truth trigger latching command vx=0 with history retained, not automatic wall recognition by the policy.
sampling_note: Each condition: centered nominal plus seed42 and seed43 each8, y +/-2cm yaw +/-2deg. Guard fractions pooled by physics-joint samples and include terminal failures. No sensor noise/dynamics randomization.
acceptance_note: Task completion and local joint-protection acceptance are separate. All stop trials complete the simulated task but none passes the local joint guard audit; not a real-robot approval.
